name: Thang co
summary: A Hmong pot of horse meat and offal simmered for hours with spices, eaten with mèn mén, grilled corn cake, and corn wine. The offal is fragrant and a little crisp, with the heat of the greens and a chili dip.
origin: Báo Sơn La, 9 September 2025, xã Co Mạ. Vietnamnet, 16 March 2019, the Mộc Châu plateau.
taste: Vietnamnet calls the horse offal fragrant and a little crisp, with the heat of the greens and a chili dip. Báo Sơn La does not print a taste.
howToEat: From the pot. Vietnamnet adds a little chili, pepper, or salt, and dips cải mèo, cải ngồng, and other greens.
where: Xã Co Mạ, on the 9 September 2025 naming. The horse pot Vietnamnet describes is on the Mộc Châu plateau, not a city street.
seoTitle: Thang co in Son La — Hmong pot, two accounts
seoDescription: Thắng cố in Sơn La. Báo Sơn La names it for the Hmong in xã Co Mạ and prints no recipe. Vietnamnet describes a horse pot on the Mộc Châu plateau.
